title: Independently replay #4470's p16 controller: exact diagonal for all 32 monomials, invoice, controls (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/pr4470-controller-replay/`. It is an independent literal Laurent replay of the p16 query-thinned complex controller in #4470 (conditional κ = 0.00302015), the maintainers' next substantive review. It covers the part #4478 left open.

**Claim type:** an independent replay by separately written code. **No new κ.**

## Results

- **Events.** 154 events: 18 `LOCAL` (exactly the thick stages), 15 `QUERY_SHEAR` (exactly the thin ones), 15 `IDLE`, 90 `ADD` and 16 `SIGNED_SWAP`.
- **Factorization.** For **all 32 monomials**, `left · W_m · right` equals the declared diagonal indicator exactly. Central exponents are ±1 (16 each), and no thin stage is credited.
- **Invoice.** The main ranks (`1 + 8|stages|` × 112), whole-idle ranks (`8|stages|` × 2 × 112) and 1,680 thin queries reproduce `CONTROLLER.json`.
- **Controls.** A flipped query orientation and a thin stage promoted to a full stage are both rejected.
- **Note.** `CONTROLLER.json`'s embedded paid and target lists use the THREE-base local profile. `RESULT.json` substitutes the joint-helper profile (checked in #4478).

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4470-controller-replay --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4470-controller-replay
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr4470-controller-replay outcome=completed   (~2 s, stdlib only)
```

Head: `0a63873be8bb6a6e1ee682f46fb48be97447b2db`. Base: canonical main `f9f85c1e`.

## Not covered

- The native word: physical contacts, phases and helper boundaries (#4504 audits frames and the local invoice).
- The BIT controller.
